title: MaizeGDB Upcoming Features & Tools Roadmap
description: Track the status of upcoming tools, genome tracks, page updates, and features across MaizeGDB.

items.title: SNPTools
items.description: SNPTools is an integrated suite for exploring maize sequence variation across multiple assemblies and resequencing datasets.

items.title: Ab initio gene models for v5 & NAM
items.description: De novo gene prediction tracks across B73 v5 and 25 NAM founder assemblies.

items.title: Transposable Element (TE) Annotations
items.description: Transposable element structural and family annotations across maize genomes.

items.title: Structural Variations (SV)
items.description: Insertions, deletions, inversions, and copy number variations mapped to B73v5 coordinates.

items.title: MaizeSNP50 Chip Probe Alignments
items.description: Array probe mapping and SNP locations for the MaizeSNP50 platform.

items.title: Core Bin Markers
items.description: Framework genetic markers defining maize chromosome bins, expanding from genome browsers to data center searches.

items.title: WGS Mapping & HapMap5 Replacement
items.description: Whole-genome sequencing alignment tracks replacing HapMap5 for high-density variation analysis.

items.title: B73v5 Methylome Data
items.description: Whole-genome bisulfite sequencing (WGBS) methylation profiles for B73 v5.

items.title: Hi-C Chromatin Interaction Tracks
items.description: 3D genomic interaction matrices and TAD boundaries for major assemblies.

items.title: Core Bin Marker Record Pages
items.description: Dedicated record pages and search interfaces for core bin markers.

items.title: NAM Functional Annotations
items.description: InterPro domain mappings, GO terms, and pathway assignments for all NAM founder gene models.

items.title: JBrowse Previews on Gene Pages
items.description: Embedded dynamic genome browser previews directly on gene record pages.

items.title: Pan-gene Tabs on Gene Pages
items.description: Syntenic ortholog matrices and pan-gene cluster membership tabs on gene pages.

items.title: NAM Physical Coordinates on Genetic Maps
items.description: Cross-referencing physical genomic locations on classical genetic maps for NAM founder lines.

items.title: MaizeMine v5 Annotations Upgrade
items.description: InterMine data warehouse upgrade integrating B73 v5 and NAM assembly gene annotations.

items.title: qTeller Multi-Tissue RNA-seq
items.description: Expression comparative tool update with multi-tissue RNA-seq datasets across NAM founders.

items.title: Pan-genome & Syntenic Ortholog Search
items.description: Multi-genome synteny exploration tool across 26 maize assembly lines.

items.title: Apollo Manual Structural Annotation Links
items.description: Direct integration and links to community Apollo instances for expert gene curation.

items.title: V5 Gene Models Linked to Gene Data
items.description: Unified cross-linking between v5 gene model IDs and classical locus records.

items.title: JBrowse Browsers for Non-NAM Assemblies
items.description: Dedicated JBrowse genome browsers for non-NAM assemblies (W22, Mo17 CAU, etc.).

items.title: JBrowse Composite Track Plugins
items.description: Multi-track composite view plugins for merging signal tracks in JBrowse.
